title: A Harbor for the Compass
author: Tamsin Nakamura
blurb: Odile Almeida, a suffragist's driver who reads every letter before delivering it, has spent three years learning which silences keep people safe. But when the army requisitions the town and the ledger with all the names, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must get the truth on the record ahead of the victors' historians, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
